widget_greeting.name: widget_greeting
widget_greeting.default: 'Hi, how can I help? Ask a question or book an appointment.'

workspaces_widget_settings.name: workspaces_widget_settings
workspaces_widget_settings.value: "workspaces"."widget_color" ~ '^#[0-9a-f]{6}$' and char_length("workspaces"."widget_greeting") between 1 and 300 and cardinality("workspaces"."widget_suggestions") <= 4 and "workspaces"."widget_position" in ('right', 'left') and cardinality("workspaces"."allowed_domains") <= 10

workspaces_booking_rules.name: workspaces_booking_rules
workspaces_booking_rules.value: "workspaces"."slot_step_minutes" in (5, 10, 15, 20, 30, 60) and "workspaces"."min_notice_minutes" between 0 and 10080 and "workspaces"."max_days_ahead" between 1 and 365 and "workspaces"."cancellation_window_hours" between 0 and 168

memberships_delete_self_or_managers.name: memberships_delete_self_or_managers
memberships_delete_self_or_managers.using: "memberships"."user_id" = (select auth.uid()) or private.has_role("memberships"."workspace_id", array['owner']) or (private.has_role("memberships"."workspace_id", array['admin']) and "memberships"."role" <> 'owner')

staff_hours_range.name: staff_hours_range
staff_hours_range.value: "staff_hours"."start_minute" between 0 and 1439 and "staff_hours"."end_minute" between 1 and 1440 and "staff_hours"."start_minute" < "staff_hours"."end_minute"

business_hours_range.name: business_hours_range
business_hours_range.value: "business_hours"."start_minute" between 0 and 1439 and "business_hours"."end_minute" between 1 and 1440 and "business_hours"."start_minute" < "business_hours"."end_minute"
